issue_context.title: Markdown doesn't render math within brackets
issue_context.body: ### Description It seems markdown doesn't render math within brackets. For example, on Github the markdown ```markdown $i = \sqrt{-1}$ ($i = \sqrt{-1}$) ``` renders as $i = \sqrt{-1}$ ($i = \sqrt{-1}$) However, on Gitea it renders differently ### Gitea Version 1.23.0+dev-218-g90bcdf9829 ### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site? Yes ### Log Gist _No response_ ### Screenshots _No response_ ### Git Version _No response_ ### Operating System _No response_ ### How are you running Gitea? Reproduced at [https://demo.gitea.com/](https://demo.gitea.com/lns/test) ### Database None

review_comments: Maybe it should only check `)` because `suceedingCharacter` can't be `(`?

Just consider that some weird patterns might exist, so I added `(`.

Maybe checking for `)` is enough.
Thank you! Let's keep it simple to avoid side effects, then add more supports one by one 😁
